description.value:
Always on (automated): +1 to Reflex and Athlete checks.

Reaction: owning any Extra Skill with “Reaction” in its name gives you a second Defense each turn (automated). Once per scene, add +2 to a Reflex and Athlete check made outside your turn.

Reskin freely as training, a perk, an implant, a technique, a gadget or a power.
